messages:
olivia: Heads-up — the EU circuit-breaker tripped an hour ago and the deploy bot auto-paused today's release slot. Can we reprioritize the queue and decide on pinning/rollback strategy? @release-manager @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: Notice: deployment hold placed on release slot 2024-11-10T15:00Z for service `inference-gateway`. Reason: circuit-breaker-eu. Queued items: 5 (ids: 9871, 9872, 9873, 9874, 9875). To resume: `/deploy resume <id>` or `/deploy override --force` (requires manager approval).

sre-oncall: We've mitigated the immediate surge but DB failover is still within stabilization window (replicas syncing). My recommendation: no global rollouts until DB lag < 2s. Pin the model runtime and avoid config/schema changes. If we must release, do a NA-only canary.

jia: I can set up a region-scoped canary if we pin the runtime and the model artifact. Suggest pin to `runtime:v2.3.1` + `model:finetune-2024-10-29`. That avoids any hot cache invalidation.

product-marketing: Also update release notes and the support blurb — call out "EU capacity limited; fallback applied" so we don't get surprised tickets. I'll draft the blurb once we confirm timing.

release-manager: Proposal: move the slot to tomorrow 08:00 UTC, run a NA-only canary at T+0, then expand to EU at T+8h if everything is green. We'll pin `inference-gateway` to `v2.3.1` during the hold and add an automatic rollback condition: if error-rate > 1.5% or P99 latency increases > 200ms for 10m, rollback to `v2.3.0`. I'll also requeue lower-priority items behind urgent fixes.

matt: Ack. I'll apply the pins now and add a note to the changelog: https://internal.company/CHANGELOG#inference-gateway — entry: "pin to v2.3.1 due to EU DB failover; rollout rescheduled".

sre-oncall: Actions captured: 1) Pin runtime/model (matt/jia). 2) Update release notes (product-marketing). 3) Reschedule slot to 08:00 UTC tomorrow (release-manager). 4) Deploybot queue reprioritized (release-manager). 5) Define automatic rollback conditions (release-manager + sre). I'll monitor DB lag and post an all-clear when < 2s for 30m.

olivia: Thanks — please @channel when the unpause is set or if we need to abort tomorrow. If we do a controlled canary, let's lock any feature flags for the gateway so we avoid config drift.

release-manager: Will do. For audit: `/release reschedule 1739215876 1739302276 --note "moved due to EU circuit-breaker; canary NA first"`. I'll ping infra to approve the override.

deploy-bot: Update: queued items 9871-9875 marked as `paused:incident-hold`. Override request states: manager_approval_required.

jia: I'll prepare the canary job and post the job id here once ready. ETA ~ 90m.

product-marketing: Drafted support blurb and changelog line. Will post for review in #marketing in 30m.

matt: Pins applied and verified in config repo: `infra/configs/inference-gateway/pins.yaml` -> `runtime: v2.3.1`, `model: finetune-2024-10-29`. Commit: abc123.

olivia: Great. Let's keep the communication tight. If SRE gives all-clear earlier we'll consider an earlier, scoped canary, otherwise stick to the new window. :thumbsup:
